findings.fix: limit to plain left press: (button & ~0b11100) == 0 (modifiers optional) or button==0; modifier click is acceptable, extended buttons should be ignored.

findings.what: tracked modes (1000/1002/1003/1006/47/1047/1049) are not reset by RIS (ESC c) or DECSTR; a killed full-screen app or `reset` in host shell leaves stale mouse_tracking, so wheel/clicks keep being forwarded to the shell as escape text (probe: modes stay {1000,1006} after ESC c). findings.fix: mark forwarded mouse/arrow sends as quiet (pending[...] = (INPUT, None)) like _query_reply.

findings.what: ESC [ 5 / ESC [ 6 (3 bytes, prefix of PgUp/PgDn and of Shift+PgUp) is held 0.5 s in flush before release; an Alt+[ followed by '5' typed within 0.5 s, or a split PgUp, is delayed at most 0.5 s.
